name: import-menu-item-opens-the-pane
description:
The app menu's Import Bookmarks and Settings item opens the Atrium settings window on the import pane.

Driven by two real clicks - the Atrium menu, then the Import item - at coordinates read off a captured frame. The menu is the stock app menu, so its geometry is Chromium's, not ours.

The click assertion was measured ABSENT on a run that opened the menu and stopped there, so it cannot pass on the menu merely appearing.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, so its menu bar is the one on screen
the Atrium menu in the menu bar
MEASUREMENT: the open menu, for reading the Import item's coordinate
the Import Bookmarks and Settings item, at a coordinate read off the measurement frame. The row has no icon, so its text starts left of the Settings text

assertions.label: the-item-was-clicked
assertions.note: absent on the measurement run, so only the click emits it
